Stat Blocks.title: Thesite Elemental
languages: understands all Primordial languages but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Burst Adaptation
traits.description: The elemental cannot have disadvantage on attack rolls or saving throws, and will produce adaptations to anything that would cause these issues for as long as they are needed. If such a roll would have disadvantage, however, it cannot have advantage on it either.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes three weapon attacks.

actions.name: Reality Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d8) force damage. If this attack provokes a concentration check made to maintain a spell, that check is made with disadvantage.

actions.name: Reality Scintillation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The elemental emits a burst of reality-shredding psychic energy from itself, targeting each creature it chooses within 30 feet. Each target must make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw, taking 17 (3d10) force damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. Then, the elemental rolls a d6 to determine one of the following effects, which immediately occurs.

options.name: Slowed Perception
options.description: Each target that fails the saving throw becomes sluggish for 1 minute.

options.name: Ongoing Erosion
options.description: Each target that fails the save takes 5 (1d8) force damage at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute.

options.name: Spell Seal
options.description: Targets who failed the saving throw must make a Concentration check each time they attempt to cast a spell, with a DC equal to 10 + the level the spell is cast at (DC 10 for cantrips). On a failure, the spell is not cast, the spell slot or ability that produced the spell isn’t spent, and the action is wasted.

options.name: Warp
options.description: The elemental can choose to teleport itself and any creature that failed the saving throw into any other unoccupied space within this effect’s range.

options.name: Restore Body
options.description: The elemental regains 9 (2d8) hit points for each creature who fails their saving throw.

options.name: Overburden
options.description: The elemental rolls a d6 twice more until it rolls two different results that aren’t 6, then produces both of those effects at the same time. It may choose not to reroll 5 if it rolls it twice, and instead uses it twice.

actions.secondary_effect_note: Each creature affected by these secondary effects repeats the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.
